I need a retry wrapper around connection to cdn.service.io:5432: 4 attempts, 1s apart.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
max=4
delay=1
for attempt in $(seq 1 "$max"); do
  if timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/cdn.service.io/5432"; then
    echo "succeeded on attempt $attempt"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "attempt $attempt failed" >&2
  sleep "$delay"
done
echo "giving up after $max attempts" >&2
exit 1
Test if access.conf is present and has content; report missing, empty, or its line count.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
file=access.conf
if [ ! -e "$file" ]; then
  echo "$file does not exist" >&2; exit 1
elif [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
  echo "$file exists but is empty"
else
  echo "$file has $(wc -l < "$file") lines"
fi
Write a small script that runs optipng on every .css file in backups, 8 jobs in parallel.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
dir=backups
find "$dir" -type f -name "*.css" -print0 \
  | xargs -0 -P 8 -n1 optipng
echo "done"
I need a rotating backup: archive /home/deploy into /srv/backup with gzip, retain 10 copies.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
src=/home/deploy
dest=/srv/backup
keep=10
mkdir -p "$dest"
stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
archive="$dest/$(basename "$src")-$stamp.tar.gz"
tar -czf "$archive" "$src"
echo "created $archive"
ls -1t "$dest"/*.tar.* | tail -n +$((keep + 1)) | xargs -r rm -f
Check whether apache2 is running and exit 0 if so, 1 otherwise, with a message.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
proc=apache2
if pgrep -x "$proc" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "$proc is running"; exit 0
else
  echo "$proc is NOT running" >&2; exit 1
fi
I need a bash script that prints the line count of each file for all .zip files under /var/www.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
dir=/var/www
for f in "$dir"/*.zip; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  wc -l -- "$f"
  echo "processed $f"
done
